gate: Source commit with successful integrated CI
owner_action_required: Recheck after source changes; this records the latest commit with a confirmed successful CI run

gate: Static site checks for recorded verified commit
owner_action_required: Repeat after future source changes

gate: Public-only build and internal-file exclusion
owner_action_required: Download or rebuild after changes; inspect release artifact before deploy

gate: Confirm domain ownership and registrar account access
evidence_or_location: No owner-supplied account evidence recorded in repository
owner_action_required: Owner verifies domain in Spaceship and keeps proof private

gate: Verify publisher mailbox is accessible and monitored
evidence_or_location: Public contact page currently names beincasinos@gmail.com
owner_action_required: Owner sends and receives a test message and confirms ongoing monitoring; do not store inbox contents here

gate: Publisher/legal identity and business disclosures
owner_action_required: Owner confirms accurate identity; obtain local professional advice where needed
release_effect: BLOCK public launch and commercial contracting

gate: BeInCasinos / BEIN trademark and naming clearance
owner_action_required: Qualified trademark review and owner decision; domain ownership is not trademark clearance

gate: Commercial hosting plan and current acceptable-use terms
owner_action_required: Owner reviews current Vercel plan and terms and explicitly approves any billing change

gate: Privacy and Moroccan Law 09-08 / CNDP review
owner_action_required: Qualified counsel/privacy professional reviews actual processing and any applicable formalities

gate: Australia online-casino promotion
owner_action_required: Keep AU online-casino promotion blocked; separately review enacted reforms and any future model with qualified counsel

gate: France online-casino promotion
owner_action_required: Keep FR online-casino promotion blocked; any distinct product category needs separate legal review

gate: United States state/product eligibility
owner_action_required: Create documented state-by-state and product-by-product matrix with exact domain/operator and affiliate rules

gate: Germany operator/product/ad-format review
owner_action_required: Check current GGL whitelist, exact domain and product scope, and advertising rules per candidate

gate: Switzerland operator/domain authorisation
owner_action_required: Verify exact entity/domain on current official authorised list and confirm product permission

gate: Great Britain licence/domain/affiliate review
owner_action_required: Verify exact UKGC entity/domain/activity and advertising/disclosure obligations for each profile
release_effect: BLOCK GB commercial links until checked

gate: Netherlands licence/audience/ad-safeguard review
owner_action_required: Verify exact Ksa permission and current affiliate/ad audience safeguards before promotion
release_effect: BLOCK NL commercial links until checked

gate: Review profiles and evidence are verified before publication
owner_action_required: Treat leads as prospects only; verify each operator, domain, product and market from current primary sources

gate: Listing fee / CPA / revshare / hybrid terms legally reviewed
owner_action_required: Counsel reviews final contract, payment model, disclosures, privacy/tracking and termination clauses

gate: Actual willingness-to-pay and traffic claims substantiated
owner_action_required: Do not claim audience, traffic, rankings or paid demand without measured/contracted evidence
release_effect: BLOCK sales claims and media-kit metrics

gate: Actual deployed host logging/cookies/network behaviour reviewed
owner_action_required: Test the real host and align privacy notice with actual processing; no non-essential tracking until approved

gate: Manual responsive/accessibility/browser acceptance tests
owner_action_required: Run documented device/browser, keyboard, zoom, contrast and tool checks; record evidence

gate: Private Vercel preview and real-host header/route verification
owner_action_required: Only after owner approves hosting setup; keep crawl block active and capture test evidence

gate: Canonical redirects, sitemap and robots verified on live host
owner_action_required: Test live HTTP responses and canonical host; do not unblock robots yet

gate: Search Console verification and sitemap submission
owner_action_required: Only after explicit launch approval and domain verification

gate: Owner's explicit public-launch approval
owner_action_required: Owner gives explicit approval only after all applicable release gates have dated evidence
